60|Stream selects SSE for this profile. true(default)=streaming; false=actual

62|poor gateway SSE implementations (empty frames, lost reasoning frames) at the cost

65|MaxTokens caps output tokens per response. 0 omits the field, using server default
66|(historical behavior). Unlike ContextWindowK, the total capacity used only locally
67|for compression thresholds, this value is sent with every request. Maps to agentcore.Options.MaxTokens.
69|MaxTokensField selects the request field for MaxTokens, only for format=openai:
70|"" = max_tokens(default); "max_completion_tokens" = newer field.
71|OpenAI reasoning models (o series/GPT-5) accept only the latter and reject max_tokens
72|as unsupported_parameter; most compatible gateways accept only the former. User selects per endpoint, no inference.
74|Nonempty SessionHeaderKey adds a custom HTTP header to every LLM request; this value is its name
75|and the current session id is its value (chat=conv-<id>, worker=exp<x>-worker-i<intent>,
76|etc.; see WorkerSessionID). Supports gateway prompt caching/sticky routing keyed by session id.
77|Empty means omit. transcript.WithSessionID places the value in request context; RoundTripper

80|Retry holds resolved parameters (profile override → global policy → built-in default,

85|RetryConfig accompanies an LLM profile. Each layer uses the same attempt semantics:
86|0 = built-in default count; negative = disable that retry layer; >0 = explicit count. Intervals:
87|0 = original exponential backoff; >0 = fixed interval.
89|ConnectAttempts/ConnectInterval: SDK pre-stream connection retries (reset/timeout/429/5xx),
90|mapped to llm.Config.MaxRetries / RetryInterval. Default 3 attempts; exponential from 0.5s, capped at 8s.

94|format only), mapped to llm.Config.EmptyResponseRetries / EmptyResponseInterval.

491|Capture raw wire responses: connection tests need the actual gateway status code and body,
492|which norma's StreamEvent decoding would discard. quotaAwareTransport finds this Capture
493|in context and fills status and body for every HTTP attempt.
496|Connection testing is a one-shot path outside the agentcore session loop, so no session id is
497|attached automatically. Endpoints configured with SessionHeaderKey (e.g. opencode zen requires
498|x-opencode-session and returns 400 MissingSessionID without it) would work for chat but
499|fail the test. Attach a one-off random session id to use the same header path as real chat.
500|Endpoints without SessionHeaderKey ignore it, with no side effects.
503|Allow sufficient MaxTokens: reasoning models (e.g. deepseek-v4-pro) generate extensive reasoning
504|before answering (even "ping" consumed ~2900 tokens in testing). With only 32 tokens the model
505|hits finish=length while reasoning and truncates; the request succeeds (err=nil) but displays
506|interrupted/length/resume. Budget enough to emit OK cleanly with finish=stop.
507|Keep EscalateMaxTokens false: no cap escalation/retry on truncation, avoiding wasteful resume loops.
514|Test using the profile's actual streaming/non-streaming mode.
520|err==nil is insufficient: requests may succeed without visible text (reasoning exhausts budget,
521|safety suppresses body, compatibility layer loses content). Such profiles fail to answer chat yet
522|would report test success. Eliminate that mismatch: no visible body always means failure.
